basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Research Associate, Project Scientist & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is recruiting candidates for 7 vacancies under the posts of Research Associate, Project Scientist, Jr. Research Fellow, Project Technical Support (II), Research Associate (a), Research Associate (b), and Research Associate (c) on a contract basis renewable yearly or upto project duration whichever earlier. Eligibility and qualification requirements vary according to the post, and pay differs by post ranging from Rs. 20,000p.m. plus HRA @30% to Rs. 58,000p.m. plus HRA @30%. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec) of IIT Delhi.
Fill out the form completely with educational qualifications, percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Send the completed application form by email to the respective Project Investigator (PI) specified for each post.
Ensure the advertisement number is mentioned clearly on the subject line of the email.
The last date for submitting completed applications by email is 28 October 2026 by 5.00 p.m.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree with first class in Public Policy, Development Studies, Geography, Sociology, Political Science, Environmental Studies, Disaster Management, Climate Change Studies, Science and Technology Studies, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated experience with qualitative research methods.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in climate-change adaptation, water governance, environmental or disaster governance, institutional analysis or mapping, public-policy research, qualitative data analysis software (NVivo, ATLAS.ti, MAXQOA).

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Electrical Engineering in first class. More than 2 years of experience in hardware designing including PCB development, microcontroller programming (ESP32, STM32).
rows.desirable_qualification: Hands-on experience with EMG sensors, IMU sensors, microcontrollers, communication protocol interfaces, circuits and system integration.

rows.essential_qualification: 1st class B.Tech./B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline. Valid GATE score. Good programming skills in MATLAB and Python.
rows.desirable_qualification: Strong fundamentals in signal processing, communication, linear algebra, and probability.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor of Arts from a recognised university with first class. More than 6 years of experience in patient handling (stroke patients in hospitals) and assistance at home for rehabilitation device training. Basic computer knowledge.
rows.desirable_qualification: Own vehicle for easy commute with valid driving license, ability to provide assistance in hardware development and device management.

rows.essential_qualification: MA in Linguistics with formal translation training/coursework and experience in AI/language research, multilingual dataset evaluation, and linguistic QA. Skilled in Gujarati, Hindi, English.
rows.desirable_qualification: IIT language/AI research collaboration, experience with language technologies, multilingual evaluation and annotation.

rows.essential_qualification: Native Marathi competency and M.A. in Translation Studies, advanced expertise in translation and applied linguistics. Must hold M.Phil. in Linguistics focusing on Error Analysis.
rows.desirable_qualification: PG Diploma in Translation Studies, experience in government-affiliated institutions, cross-linguistic analysis.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (BTech) or related discipline with dedicated research experience. Experience with Indian languages in computational settings, LLMs, bias and responsible AI.
rows.desirable_qualification: Familiarity with foundational NLP tasks, strong analytical and programming skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointments are made on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. For retired or superannuated government employees selected for a post, salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates based on advertised qualifications and project requirements. Short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: Appointments are made on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the consolidated fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance (HRA) @30% or @27% is applicable on top of the consolidated fellowship where specified in the post details (such as @30% for the Research Associate under Public Policy and Project Technical Support II, and @27% for the JRF).

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks?
faq.answer: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates during short-listing or selection.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be notified of the interview?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with online interview details, and only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview.

faq.question: Q5. What should be included in the email subject line when applying?
faq.answer: Candidates must include the Advertisement Number (such as IITD/IRD/284/2026) on the subject line of the email when sending their application to the respective PI.
